content.json:
# FCA Handbook Assistant - regulated AI dashboard
Grounding, refusal rate, latency, and token cost from the custom metrics emitted by the app.

content.query: customMetrics | where name in ('handbook.answers', 'handbook.refusals') | summarize total = sum(valueSum) by name
content.title: Answers vs refusals

content.query: customMetrics | where name in ('handbook.prompt_tokens', 'handbook.completion_tokens') | summarize tokens = sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, 1h), name | render timechart
content.title: Token usage over time

content.query: customMetrics | where name == 'handbook.latency_ms' | summarize p50 = percentile(valueSum / valueCount, 50), p95 = percentile(valueSum / valueCount, 95) by bin(timestamp, 15m) | render timechart
content.title: Answer latency (p50 / p95, ms)
